notes: Trend card: SG TEMP COMPENSATE button removed from the UI.  The correction transform (SG to 68 F) was counterintuitive in practice -- during cold crash it makes SG appear to rise, and it mismatches BF's own logs at any non-68 F temperature.  Underlying pipeline (sg-compensate.js and readingsForAnalysis) stays intact so we can revisit if we ever want it back.

Trend card fix: SG TEMP COMPENSATE no longer shoves the WINDOW/FULL/TEMP/°F/°C/COMPENSATE buttons to the far right edge of the card.  With space-between removed from the toolbar row, the button cluster stays glued to the SG TREND title on the left; the info text still right-aligns via margin-left: auto, wrapping to a second row cleanly when compensate is on rather than shifting the buttons.

Dashboard: new inline "REFRESH FROM BREWER'S FRIEND" button on the right of the FG DIAGNOSTICS header.  One click pulls the freshest readings from BF via the shared Cloudflare Worker and re-runs FG analysis, no tab-switching needed.  Button reports its own progress (Refreshing / Loaded N / Error) and self-disables for 3 s after each click to prevent accidental double-taps.

Dashboard: new fermentation block ported from FermTrend -- summary strip (SESSION / OG / CURRENT SG / TEMP / READINGS), DATA STALE banner, compact FERMENTATION STATUS bar, SG trend chart with Window/Full modes, Temp overlay, F vs C, SG Temp Compensate, drag-to-set analysis window, and expanded FG DIAGNOSTICS panel.
Under the hood: browser now fetches Brewers Friend readings directly via the shared fermtrend-proxy Cloudflare Worker, eliminating the paginated on-Pico history fetch that caused OOM crashes during Refresh History and the 8 h auto-refresh tick.  Pico keeps the lightweight status poll that feeds the DATA STALE banner and email alerts.
DWELL enforced with every Pico startup to prevent power outage short-cycling
Pico is now authoritative vor freshest reading age
